facts.fact: The Prime Minister inaugurated two modular government-cloud data centres on 23 January 2026 as a key step of the strategic chantier "zéro donnée à l'extérieur", aimed at hosting, operating and securing all public data and repatriating data still stored abroad.
The Primature states the two government-cloud data centres inaugurated on 23 January 2026 are to host all public data under the "zéro donnée à l'extérieur" chantier; no body is stated to have moved.
